description: A custom Android UI component called RoundedTimeBar that extends ExoPlayer's DefaultTimeBar to render a rounded, pill-shaped track with distinct segments for unplayed, buffered, and played portions, optimized for Material 3 styling.

classes.name: RoundedTimeBar
classes.description: A custom UI widget extending DefaultTimeBar to display a rounded, styled progress track with buffered and played segments, customizable via theme and attributes.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Overrides DefaultTimeBar.setDuration to update internal duration state and trigger redraw.

methods.name: setPosition
methods.description: Overrides DefaultTimeBar.setPosition to update current position and trigger redraw.

methods.name: setBufferedPosition
methods.description: Overrides DefaultTimeBar.setBufferedPosition to update buffered position and trigger redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Custom drawing method that renders the pill-shaped track segments according to current playback state, then delegates to superclass for scrubber and markers.
